text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Leaders of main opposition parties hold talks in Rabat on common candidates for parliamentary elections.
- U.N. secretary-general's personal representative for Western Sahara, James Baker, arrives on Wednesday in Ramadan on peace mission for disputed territory.
- Delegation of German parliamentarians to start visit to Morocco on Sunday.
- Phosphate Moroccan OCP firm signs $30 million accord with Brazilian fertiliser Trevo group.
- Government allocates some 14 million dirhams to finance housing programme.
- Morocco exported 6,500 tonnes of oranges to Saudi Arabia in 1996.
- Morocco's lawyers hold congress this week in central city of Fez underscore commitment to defend human rights.
